yt_description:
Missed another tender deadline? Buried in RFP PDFs, spreadsheet out of date, bid lost by an hour.

Turn your tender spreadsheets into a Tender Portal on Stackby. Import your tender tracker and every tender, RFP, deadline and bid document is tracked in one place, for IT, construction, energy and any business that bids.

Then let AI field agents read every RFP: deadline, budget, mandatory requirements and a go/no-go recommendation, right in your table.

What's inside
• Bid pipeline from qualify to won
• Compliance checklist for every bid document
• Deadline calendar with automated reminders
• AI RFP analyst for go/no-go decisions

👉 Build your Tender Portal, free to start: https://stackby.com/signup
